title: Haloumi and Roast Veggie Pasta
subtitle: with Toasted Almonds and Rocket
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Roast veggies: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Cut the capsicum into 2cm chunks. Cut the tomatoes into wedges. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Put the capsicum, tomato, garlic, Scandinavian seasoning and 2 tsp olive oil in a 1.5L (6 cup) baking dish. Season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Roast for 20 mins or until the veggies are tender.

Cook pasta: Meanwhile, bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil. Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 10 mins or until al dente. Reserve 60ml (¼ cup) cooking water, then drain the pasta and return to the pan.

Cook haloumi: While the pasta is cooking, thinly slice the haloumi. Put the almonds in a cold medium frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 2 mins each side or until golden. Remove from the pan.

Toss together: Lightly mash the roasted veggies in the dish with a fork. Add the mashed veggies, reserved cooking water, 2 tbs tomato paste and 1 tsp sugar to the pasta and toss to combine. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Serve up: Combine 2 tsp olive oil and 1 tsp balsamic vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the rocket and toss to coat. Divide the pasta and haloumi among bowls and scatter over the almonds. Serve with the dressed rocket and enjoy!
Make it cheesy: Like your pasta extra cheesy? If you have some on hand, scatter over finely grated parmesan before serving.
